_doc: Evidence-page map for verify.py --live-audit. Tasks not listed use their start_url. Where the expected answer lives on a page the agent reaches by navigation (detail/category/tag/author pages), or on the JSON/HTML endpoint a JS page renders from, that page is listed here. This file is an audit aid: it is NOT hashed into the suite version and changing it never changes a frozen task. 'count' rules: an answer that is a number is checked as the sum of class="<class>" elements across the listed pages (paginated categories list every page).
